info.title: EpicPanel API
info.description:
EpicPanel hosting control plane. Canonical prefix: /api/v1 (the /v1 spelling is equivalent).

Principal types (Authorization: Bearer <token>):
- Session: browser cookie or session token (full role of the user).
- `epk_` org API token: org-confined automation identity; deny-by-default scopes
  (x_scope on each operation). Never inherits platform-admin. CSRF-exempt.
- `epa_` platform admin API key: operates across ALL organizations with the
  platform-admin role; needs the org scope for /v1/organizations/... routes and
  admin:read/admin:write for the /v1/admin* + /v1/jobs surface. Create/revoke via
  admin SESSION only (POST/DELETE /v1/admin/api-keys).
- `agt_` agent token: data-plane agent channel only.

Mutating infrastructure operations (provision, install, deploy, backup, DNS sync, ...)
return 202 with a job_id; poll GET .../jobs/{id} or subscribe to GET /v1/ws.

Short URLs (ADR-060): every /v1/organizations/{org_id}/X route is ALSO served at /v1/X -
the caller's active organization resolves server-side (org tokens: their bound org;
otherwise the X-EpicPanel-Org header if present, else the caller's primary org).
Every account is created inside its own personal organization, so /v1/websites just works.

Errors: JSON {error: {code, message, details?}}. Rate limits: 10/min auth, 300/min API.

post.summary: Register user (first user = platform admin; locked after setup)
Login (sets session cookie; returns bearer-capable token)
Register server (platform admin; one-time reg token)
Exchange one-time reg token for agent token
Suspend site with optional reason (admin+); bandwidth_exhausted/attack are system-reserved
Resume site (admin+); blocked with 409 while the bandwidth quota stays exhausted unless force
Terminate site (admin+; confirm:true required): 410 stub + app processes stopped, files kept for audit
Purge a TERMINATED site (admin+; confirm:true): destructive removal via the delete job

get.summary: Current bandwidth state: quota surface, period usage, live egress rate (billing+)
Bucketed bandwidth history (interval=hour|day; hourly retained 90d, daily indefinite)
Site quota: monthly bandwidth budget (per-site override or plan), used, reset (billing+)

patch.summary: Set/clear the per-site bandwidth override: bandwidth_limit_mb (0=unlimited, null=plan) (admin+)

post.summary: One-click Laravel (composer create-project as site user) -> job
Run allowlisted site command (composer/npm/artisan/...) -> job with output

get.summary: Dynamic resources status (traffic trend, tier, state, decisions)

patch.summary: Enable/disable traffic-adaptive allocation on a site (developer+)

post.summary: Restore a site suspended/throttled by the allocator (developer+)
Assign the Free Perk resource overlay (developer+; per-org cap)

get.summary: Free Perk status for the org (cap/used/package)

post.summary: Set SSL mode none|selfsigned|letsencrypt -> cert job

get.summary: Web terminal (WebSocket; interactive session only — API keys refused)

post.summary: Create org API token (raw shown once)
Create platform admin API key (admin SESSION only; raw shown once; scope '*' = full control)

delete.summary: Revoke platform admin API key (admin SESSION only)

patch.summary: Update hosting package (sites converge via enforce jobs)

post.summary: Create user account (cPanel model: admins create customers)

get.summary: Dynamic resources: panel config + fleet overview (platform admin)

patch.summary: Update dynamic-resources config (toggle, floor, windows, perk cap, engine cooldowns, max tier, governor caps) (platform admin)

get.summary: Audit trail (org members billing+; all orgs for platform admin)
WebSocket event stream (session or org token; org-scoped frames)

bearer.description: Session token, epk_ org token, epa_ platform key, or agt_ agent token
